title: Wire the macOS desktop driver into the service
goal: The running service records and replays through the live desktop driver, behind approval cards
acceptance: The service builds the macOS desktop driver when Accessibility is granted to its node binary, and doctor and every desktop tool say "desktop control not available: grant Accessibility to <binary> ..." when it is not; NERV never requests or changes the grant
desktop.record (Blue, owner tool) records the mouse only, never keys, for 1 to 60 seconds into a mode-0600 file in the data home, after its approval card

desktop.replay is bound to the recording file's hash, app, window and display when proposed, runs only after the owner approves that card, keeps the display, front-app and window preconditions, stops on owner input or a focus change, releases held buttons and taints the sortie with the read-back
A join test runs the store's gate, the desktop control and a fake driver and input session; the default control refuses under the test runner; no test reads or moves the real mouse
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 after the owner approved this step in chat ("A. Approve an agent step that wires up the driver"): helper input commands, service binding, card binding, tests with a fake driver. Closed 2026-11-26: PR #817 CI run 45814589972 passed all five jobs. No actual: started in an earlier session.
